setup: docker compose on an Apple M4 laptop: Mosquitto 2.0, edge agent container (--cpus 0.5, 256 MB, ONNX isolation forest), simulator replaying 2,000 hours x 8 SYNTHETIC sensors (4 Dhaka locations x PM2.5/PM10, modelled Mendeley values, 6 injected faults per sensor) at 100 messages/s, FastAPI app + Postgres. Method: scripts/edge_demo.sh then scripts/edge_report.py.
events: v1 published to models/manifest.json before the stream; gateway swapped local -> v1
app (uplink) stopped for 20 s, starting 40 s into the stream
v2 published 3 s after the uplink returned; gateway swapped v1 -> v2 while the stream was still running (v2 = the same weights re-published: the demo exercises the delivery path, not a better model)
